basic_profile.bio: Avid Brawlhalla player and pun enthusiast from Canada. I've been on Reddit for over 5 years, mostly lurking in subreddits related to gaming and a few niche interests. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to browse Reddit during odd hours. I'm currently single and spend my free time exploring new video games and catching up on my favorite sci-fi series. I dislike overly serious discussions and prefer to keep things light and humorous.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in various video games and graphic design, I often share tips and engage in light-hearted banter about game mechanics and characters. My knowledge stems from years of playing and participating in online communities.
